title: HotKeyPractice
description: A Spigot plugin that improves hotkeying skills through customizable challenges and a built-in score
body:
**HotKeyPractice** is a lightweight and straightforward Spigot plugin designed to help players improve their hotkeying skills while adding a competitive edge with its built-in score system. With just a simple command, players receive a random inventory where one of the items is a target block. The challenge? Hotkey to that target block as quickly and accurately as possible!

As you successfully hotkey to the target block, your score increases, and the game continues. Test your reflexes, climb the leaderboard, and see how far you can go before missing the target!

**Features:**

Generate a random inventory with a single command.
Includes a target block that players must hotkey to.
Built-in score system that keeps the game going and tracks your progress.
Customizable settings to tailor the experience:
Define the blocks that might appear as junk items in the player’s hotbar.
Set the specific target item players need to switch to.
Adjust the time players have to switch to the target item.
Simple setup, easy to use, and compatible with most Spigot versions.
Perfect for players looking to improve their quick-access skills and challenge themselves.
Download HotKeyPractice today and take your hotkeying to the next level while competing for the highest score!

**Commands**

/hotkeypractice start - Starts a hotkey practice game.

/hotkeypractice stop - Stops your current hotkey practice game.

/hotkeypractice help - Displays this list.

/hotkeypractice reload - Reloads the plugin's config.
